text:
sam: heads-up — Nimbus Labs (acct 9882) replied to our overdue notice for INV-2026-072. they dispute a $2,500 'egress data transfer' line and asked us to pause collections while they reconcile with their cloud provider. attached short screenshot.

anika: can you paste the invoice lines theyre calling out? i'll pull transfer logs.

sam: pasted snippet:

```
INV-2026-072
Date: 2026-06-18
Total: $26,750.00
1) Platform subscription: $15,000.00
2) Usage (tokens): $9,250.00
3) Egress data transfer: $2,500.00  <-- disputed
```

collections-bot: automated: dunning reminder sent to billing@nimbus.ai for INV-2026-072 on 2026-06-25 12:05 UTC.

bryan: pulling network egress events for 2026-06-15 to 06-17. i see a large transfer initiated by export_job_7722 and a duplicate record export_job_7722-retry; the CDN webhook replayed and produced two meter events for the same bytes. looks like double-count.

anika: ack. recommend crediting the $2,500 and pausing dunning. this is within collections credit limit. i'll prepare credit memo.

sam: collections policy check: credits <= $3k OK by manager. please apply credit and pause automated reminders. also offer a 3-installment payment plan for the remainder as a courtesy? client flagged cashflow issues.

bryan: created credit memo CM-2026-054 for $2,500 and applied to INV-2026-072. regenerated invoice INV-2026-072-R1 with new total $24,250. linked ticket ZD-4815.

collections-bot: automated: collections workflow paused for INV-2026-072 by collections (sam) at 2026-06-25 13:02 UTC.

anika: drafting reply to Nimbus: we've identified a duplicated egress meter event and issued a $2,500 credit. attached INV-2026-072-R1. to help with cashflow we can offer a 3-installment plan (1/3 now, 1/3 in 30 days, 1/3 in 60 days) with late fees waived this cycle. need ACH or card on file and AM sign-off.

nimbus.billing (via email paste): thanks — appreciate the quick response. 3-installment plan works. can you confirm the dates and provide payment links?

sam: confirm plan terms: payment 1 due immediately, payment 2 due +30 days, payment 3 due +60 days. waive late fees for current invoice cycle. require payment method on file and signed agreement. if first payment missed, plan voids and normal dunning resumes. documented in ZD-4815.

bryan: created ENG-9410 to add idempotency keys to CDN/webhook metering ingestion to prevent replay double-bills. assigned to eng-runtime. included example events export_job_7722.

anika: added calendar follow-ups for 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-24 to verify payments. if Nimbus misses any installment escalate to salesOps.

sam: replying to Nimbus now with INV-2026-072-R1, payment links, and payment plan agreement. cc'ing AM.

collections-bot: automated: follow-up reminder set for 2026-07-25 to check first installment for INV-2026-072.

sam: closing thread for now. small ops note: ops to add a standard payment-plan template to speed approvals. tagging finance-ops. :white_check_mark:
